COM.name: Comma
COM.purpose: Lane and Link initialization and management; symbol alignment marker.

STP.name: Start TLP
STP.purpose: Marks the start of a Transaction Layer Packet.

SDP.name: Start DLLP
SDP.purpose: Marks the start of a Data Link Layer Packet.

END.name: End
END.purpose: Marks the end of a TLP or DLLP.

EDB.name: End Bad
EDB.purpose: Marks the end of a nullified TLP.

PAD.name: Pad
PAD.purpose: Used in Framing and Link Width and Lane ordering negotiations.

SKP.name: Skip
SKP.purpose: Compensates for different bit rates between two communicating ports (clock-tolerance).

FTS.name: Fast Training Sequence
FTS.purpose: Used within an ordered-set to exit from L0s to L0.

IDL.name: Idle
IDL.purpose: Electrical Idle symbol used in the Electrical Idle Ordered Set.

lcrc_polynomial.name: CRC-16-CCITT (TLP LCRC + DLLP CRC)
lcrc_polynomial.covers: TLP: Sequence Number + TLP body. DLLP: DLLP type + DLLP-specific fields.

ecrc_polynomial.name: CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3 / Ethernet)
ecrc_polynomial.covers: End-to-end TLP integrity (optional, when TD = 1 in the TLP header).

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.lane_data_striping: Lane 0 carries the first byte of any TLP/DLLP; STP/SDP must be placed on Lane 0.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.scrambling_polynomial: x^16 + x^5 + x^4 + x^3 + 1 (data is scrambled before 8b/10b encoding; SKP/COM/training-set symbols are NOT scrambled)

default_signal_values_when_idle.TX_in_Electrical_Idle: Output driven to common-mode; no symbol stream; receiver detects via low-pass differential threshold.
default_signal_values_when_idle.TX_in_L0_no_packet: Continuously transmit 00h (Logical Idle) on all Lanes, scrambled and 8b/10b-encoded; SKP ordered set inserted every 1180-1538 symbols.
